❌ 3.1 - REPNODE M7

ACT 3 - Mars, REPNODE M7
第三幕 - 火星，REPNODE M7

Leave the ship, read the diary and message aurana.
离开飞船，阅读日记和给奥拉娜的信息。

You are given two files and a name “Christopher Selm Tong”
你会得到两个文件和一个名字“Christopher Selm Tong”

Open the files, and click the cito16 link on one. https://cito16-storage.corie
打开文件，然后点击其中一个文件上的 cito16 链接。https://cito16-storage.corie
You can message Aurana again after. Opening the Dossier C.S. Tong file will add the text-equivalent of the dossier called “Dossier C.S. Tong - Text” to your codex.
之后你可以再次给 Aurana 发消息。打开 Dossier C.S. Tong 文件会将名为“Dossier C.S. Tong - Text”的档案文本等价内容添加到你的法典中。

This unlocks the network map tool in your toolbar. And we are told to connect to RM7-E1L2CT.
这会解锁你工具栏中的网络地图工具。然后我们被告知要连接到 RM7-E1L2CT。
Network map icon:
网络地图图标：


Click on this node in the map and “Connect”
在地图中点击此节点并选择“连接”
Aurana now messages to retry the cito16 browser page.
Aurana 现在发来消息，要求重试 cito16 浏览器页面。

This page has one downloadable file, KRVA_BB.eb52x.
此页面有一个可下载文件，KRVA_BB.eb52x。
Download and open it, it’ll error and you can message Aurana about it.Once the conversation is completed, re-open the file to receive the “KRVA_BB Project Files” codex entry.
下载并打开它，它会报错，然后你可以就此给 Aurana 发消息。对话完成后，重新打开该文件即可获得“KRVA_BB 项目文件”法典条目。

Back in the NW Map (Network Map) Click “Home” then “Market”.
回到 NW 地图（网络地图），点击“主页”，然后点击“市场”。


Here we can find upgrades to allow us to do more work, along with jobs.
在这里我们可以找到允许我们做更多工作的升级，以及各种任务。
For now, we need to buy “Cypher+ v1.4”, as of writing this costs 6400 CR and 1 CRL. This is the only DECRYPT software available to you at the moment. And it also lists its supported extensions, .eb52x and .ab52p.
目前，我们需要购买“Cypher+ v1.4”，在撰写本文时，它的价格为 6400 CR 和 1 CRL。这是目前唯一可供你使用的解密软件。它还列出了其支持的扩展名：.eb52x 和 .ab52p。

After purchase, click the loadout button on the toolbar and install CYPER+
购买后，点击工具栏上的装备按钮并安装 CYPER+
(Power off at top, install, power on)
（顶部断电，安装，通电）

Loadout icon:
装备图标：

Opening the file gives us a hacking minigame. A helpful tool for it can be found on the Tools page.
打开文件会进入一个黑客小游戏。可以在“工具”页面找到一个有用的辅助工具。

Open the file after to see the KRVA_BB Drone. Click INFO to see a path.
之后打开文件即可看到 KRVA_BB 无人机。点击“信息”查看路径。
Visit this in the browser
在浏览器中访问此页面
https://RM7-E1L2CT.local/storage
Then contact Aurana again.
然后再次联系 Aurana。

We now go back to the market to buy “Porter-Lite r4” for, at the time of writing, 13,225 CR (Visiting the website in the previous step gave us 14,000 CR.)
现在我们回到市场购买“Porter-Lite r4”，在撰写本文时价格为 13,225 CR（上一步访问网站给了我们 14,000 CR。）

To install porter, we either need to buy better hardware, or disable CYPHER. Before doing this, in the market, take on the decryption jobs, and complete them. It's the same match game as above, each pays ~800CR.
要安装 porter，我们需要么购买更好的硬件，要么禁用 CYPHER。在此之前，在市场接取解密任务并完成它们。这和上面的配对游戏一样，每个任务支付~800CR。


Then enable Porter, then in the Network Map, click the E1L2CT box and login. Porter is an option here.
然后启用 Porter，接着在 Network Map 中点击 E1L2CT 框并登录。Porter 在这里是一个选项。
It's the same match up game again.
又是同样的配对游戏。

On the FILES tabs, there are three files to find, and download.
在 FILES 选项卡上，有三个文件需要找到并下载。


Email: From: Chris_Tong.txt
电子邮件：发件人：Chris_Tong.txt
Component_board 71review.txt
Mantis_drone_r4RD(TONG).png

Open them all and talk to Aurana.
把它们全部打开，然后和 Aurana 交谈。

Market > Hire. Your merc will have a random name, He costs 8k. If you can't buy him, refresh.
市场 > 雇佣。你的雇佣兵会有一个随机名字，他花费 8k。如果你买不了他，就刷新。
You pay part up front and the rest on completion, don't spend all your money!
你先付一部分，剩下的完工后再付，别把钱全花光了！

In the meantime, clean up any leftover market jobs, and connect to all available servers.
与此同时，清理掉所有剩余的市场任务，并连接到所有可用的服务器。

WHEN DOING SERVER JOBS, HAVE THE SERVER UI CLOSED BEFORE ACCEPTING THE JOB.
做服务器任务时，在接受任务之前先关闭服务器界面。
If you don't, then the required file or IP will not appear in the list.
如果不这样做，所需的文件或 IP 就不会出现在列表中。
Leaving the server UI on “Summary” appears to be okay.
将服务器界面保持在“摘要”上似乎没问题。

To Hack into RM7 E1SCP, we need 12 Hack Power, to do this, we need to buy the UNO CPU in the market and equip it.
要入侵 RM7 E1SCP，我们需要 12 点黑客能力，为此，我们需要在市场上购买 UNO CPU 并装备它。

To Equip the CPU go to LOADOUT, Power OFF, change CPU to UNO CPU you just bought, Power On
要装备 CPU，请前往“装备配置”，关闭电源，将 CPU 更换为你刚购买的 UNO CPU，然后开启电源。



When the merc returns, you can pay him on the expeditions page, this is 7,200CR. (the remaining part of the 12k).
当雇佣兵返回时，你可以在探险页面支付他费用，金额为 7,200CR。（12k 中剩余的部分。）
Open the container and claim the TX Board.
打开容器并领取 TX 板。
You can discuss with Aurana the results of the expedition.
你可以与奥拉娜讨论探险的结果。

Following this, you are told to use the market, send out more mercs and do jobs.
随后，你会被告知使用市场，派遣更多雇佣兵并执行任务。

It’s likely that we will need to earn enough rep and CR to upgrade the machine we are using.
我们很可能需要赚取足够的声望和 CR 来升级我们正在使用的机器。

Keep completing jobs, either by finding and deleting files, or adding and removing IPs.
继续完成任务，无论是通过查找并删除文件，还是添加和移除 IP。
You can hire more mercs after completing the first job, they get more and more expensive slowly, and they have a “type”
完成第一个任务后，你可以雇佣更多佣兵，他们的价格会逐渐变得越来越贵，而且他们有一个“类型”
This affects how many events occur during their expeditions. If an event occurs, it may have selectable options.
这会影响他们探险期间发生的事件数量。如果发生事件，可能会有可选择的选项。
You have 5 mins to make a selection or the merc will auto pick the “safe” option, which may skip out on loot.
你有 5 分钟的时间做出选择，否则佣兵将自动选择“安全”选项，这可能会错过战利品。

There are careful mercs that get about 1 event an hour, and there are fast mercs that get one every few mins.
有些雇佣兵很谨慎，大约每小时才触发一次事件；而有些雇佣兵则很快，每隔几分钟就能触发一次。
When an event happens, the site does play a noise. So it's advised to go to the sound settings in the help menu and disable the ambient noise.
事件发生时，网站会播放提示音。因此建议前往帮助菜单中的声音设置，关闭环境音效。
Then leave the site open in a tab and listen for the notification to then check back in.
然后把网站开着放在一个标签页里，听到通知后再回来查看。

After connecting to E1SCP, a new server RM7 S4L4 shows up on the map.
连接到 E1SCP 后，地图上会出现一个新服务器 RM7 S4L4。

RM7 E1SCP has a file sw12_sec_report_2341245.txt that gets added to the desktop. The text in this file is a hidden IP
RM7 E1SCP 有一个文件 sw12_sec_report_2341245.txt 被添加到桌面上。该文件中的文本是一个隐藏 IP
855.528.0.4 

"And it came to pass in the days of the eighth generation, that the elder of the Fifty and Five Keys did gather the multitude, making fifty and two souls in the Valley of Sorrow for the eighth time. Then did the Lord command them silence, saying: Let the number of the void stay eternal, for the Fourth Seal shall summon the Tide of Change.
“到了第八代的日子，五十五钥中的长者第八次在悲伤之谷聚集了会众，共五十二人。于是主命令他们安静，说：让虚空之数永存，因为第四封印将召唤变革之潮。

Search for this in the Network Map to unlock new nodes
在网络地图中搜索此项以解锁新节点


For this to work, RM7-E1L5 and RM7-E1SCP must not be on maintenance.
为此，RM7-E1L5 和 RM7-E1SCP 必须不处于维护状态。

D4RK RM7MI has a new market of its own, with new gear.
D4RK RM7MI 拥有自己的新市场，还有新装备。
It has its own CRL Rep, and its own (more valuable) jobs!
它有自己的 CRL 代表，还有自己的（更有价值的）工作！
New CPU, RAM, a new Search and decrypt software are for sale.
新的 CPU、内存、新的搜索和解密软件正在出售。



NOTE: If you completed Act 2, Stage 9, you can find the file 5CRYPT0L in the Silver Odyssey Folder and open it. This gives you the software for free, instead of the market price of 42,250CR
注意：如果你完成了第二幕第九阶段，你可以在 Silver Odyssey 文件夹中找到 5CRYPT0L 文件并打开它。这样你就能免费获得该软件，而无需支付 42,250CR 的市场价。

As yet unconfirmed, but it appears that getting to REP 3 on the D4RK RM7MI server allows D4RK servers to be specified in jobs, if these have “Access Grant”, it means we can login to the server.
尚未确认，但似乎只要在 D4RK RM7MI 服务器上达到 REP 3，就可以在任务中指定 D4RK 服务器，如果这些服务器有“访问授权”，就意味着我们可以登录该服务器。

D4RK RM7CE has no new files. The others may have what we need to progress!
D4RK RM7CE 没有新文件。其他服务器可能有我们需要的东西来推进进度！

As of 24th April (V1.18.80) Jobs from the market now grant +3 account renown xp, and successful expeditions give +10.
截至 4 月 24 日（V1.18.80），市场任务现在给予+3 账户声望经验值，成功远征给予+10。

Update V1.18.182 - May 8th.
更新 V1.18.182 - 5 月 8 日。
New servers, new tools, new hardware, game center “app” on the bottom bar.
新服务器、新工具、新硬件，底栏新增游戏中心“应用”。

Game Center contains the daily task, and also a tower defence game.
游戏中心包含每日任务，还有一个塔防游戏。
At this time there is no reason to play this, although it is a fun lil distraction.
目前没有理由玩这个，不过它是个有趣的小消遣。

D4RK Market got some new goodies and a REP cap change (up to 5?)
D4RK 市场新增了一些好东西，声望上限也改了（最高 5？）
At rep 4 there is a new hack tool, H0pp3r, which is a combo of Hack, search and decrypt.
在声望 4 时有一个新的黑客工具，H0pp3r，它是黑客、搜索和解密的结合体。

It can only hack and search PUBLIC CEDRT servers -
它只能入侵和搜索公共 CEDRT 服务器——

However it does completely replace CYPHER+, the starting decryption software, and is more powerful.
然而它完全取代了初始解密软件 CYPHER+，并且更加强大。
5Crypt0l has an extra file type compared to this
5Crypt0l 相比这个多了一种文件类型
PORTER-LITE can access CEDRT Private.
PORTER-LITE 可以访问 CEDRT Private。

It's not a replacement for all software, but a jack of all trades at this time.
它并不能替代所有软件，但目前是个多面手。

Upon reaching REP 4 on D4RK, new hardware is available to see, a new PSU and GPU, but these require REP 5 to buy.
在 D4RK 上达到 REP 4 后，可以看到新的硬件，一个新的 PSU 和 GPU，但这些需要 REP 5 才能购买。

On the server map a new server appears, RM7-N2ECP. You can hack this with a new minigame, the “ICE WALL BREAK” or Pyramid.
在服务器地图上会出现一个新服务器，RM7-N2ECP。你可以通过一个新的小游戏“ICE WALL BREAK”或 Pyramid 来入侵它。

You need to find the pattern on the top left within the right hand larger image. The right image will slowly show more and more glyphs until it's full. But you must complete 3 rounds to access the server. Choosing an incorrect placement will cost you a 20 second penalty.
你需要在右侧较大的图像中找到左上角的图案。右侧图像会逐渐显示越来越多的符号，直到完全显示。但你必须完成 3 轮才能访问服务器。选择错误的位置将导致 20 秒的惩罚。


Connect and hack your way all the way through to find all of the Soyuz servers.
连接并一路入侵，找到所有联盟号服务器。



Server RM7-W3L2 is currently permanently in maintenance.
服务器 RM7-W3L2 目前处于永久维护状态。
SRM7-M has a new market!
SRM7-M 有了新的市场！

It has jobs, and new hardware + software.
它有任务，以及新的硬件+软件。

The SW available is to hack and search SOYUZ Public servers.
可用的软件是用来入侵和搜索 SOYUZ 公共服务器的。
The PSU is better than other options currently.
PSU 目前比其他选项更好。


Current thought is to hit Soyuz rep 2 and start hacking those servers to see new files.
目前的想法是达到 Soyuz 声望 2 级，然后开始入侵那些服务器以查看新文件。

Two extra hidden connections can be revealed which helps in case maintenance happens on the route.
可以发现两条额外的隐藏连接，这在路由需要进行维护时会有所帮助。
The hidden connection between RM7-N1L1 and RM7-N2ECP can be revealed by searching the IP address of either of the servers: 855.529.4.1 or 855.529.4.13. The hidden connection between SRM7-N3L2 and RM7-N2L2 is revealed in the same fashion, by searching either 855.529.4.17 or 855.529.4.2.
RM7-N1L1 与 RM7-N2ECP 之间的隐藏连接可以通过搜索任一服务器的 IP 地址来发现：855.529.4.1 或 855.529.4.13。SRM7-N3L2 与 RM7-N2L2 之间的隐藏连接也以同样的方式发现，搜索 855.529.4.17 或 855.529.4.2 即可。

>> Update 3.41.0 has unlocked new content on the 22nd of May
>> 3.41.0 更新已于 5 月 22 日解锁新内容

First talk to Aurana to kick things off. (this seems a little bugged!) When you finish talking with Aurana, message the CEDRT Work Chat (where Chris Tong is) and progress the dialogue until he gives you the task of checking out a server with a provided IP of 855.529.2.2 Put that in the search field in the Network Map.
首先与 Aurana 交谈以启动流程。（这似乎有点小 bug！）当你结束与 Aurana 的对话后，给 CEDRT Work Chat（Chris Tong 所在的地方）发消息，并推进对话，直到他给你一个任务，让你用提供的 IP 地址 855.529.2.2 去检查一台服务器。把该地址输入网络地图中的搜索字段。

Connect to the new server EM[RM7-E2L2] (using the top option from the possible “Task Access” options), logging into the server grants the achievement “Compromised Server”. Download and decrypt the file connections_log_recovered.log and read the IP 855.529.4.22 from it.
连接到新服务器 EM[RM7-E2L2]（使用可能的“任务访问”选项中的顶部选项），登录服务器即可获得成就“已入侵服务器”。下载并解密文件 connections_log_recovered.log，并从中读取 IP 855.529.4.22。

Put that IP into the Network map search again then connect to the server, the unknown user will contact you and another server appears, EM[UNDEFINED]. To hack that server, you will need the tool “RE-nova v3.0” from the home market. After hacking in, you can download the files attack_logs.log and ad_note.png.
将该 IP 再次输入网络地图搜索，然后连接到服务器，未知用户会联系你，并出现另一个服务器 EM[UNDEFINED]。要入侵该服务器，你需要从家庭市场购买工具“RE-nova v3.0”。入侵后，你可以下载文件 attack_logs.log 和 ad_note.png。

Alternatively you can purchase the “firewall” named Nutcracker from the Home market and give it to the unknown user to gain Task Access to the EM[UNDEFINED] server, which will then also let you acquire the attack_logs.log and ad_note.png files. Once you provide the file in a dialogue to Chris in the CEDRT Work Chat, finish the dialogue and then report back to Aurana. These steps can currently bug out, repeat the entire process including searching for the IPs and ensure you use any Task/SAI Access buttons when logging into the servers that show as “NEW”.
或者，你可以从家庭市场购买名为 Nutcracker 的“防火墙”，并将其交给未知用户，以获得对 EM[UNDEFINED] 服务器的任务访问权限，这样你也能获取 attack_logs.log 和 ad_note.png 文件。一旦你在 CEDRT 工作聊天中通过对话将文件提供给 Chris，完成对话，然后向 Aurana 汇报。这些步骤目前可能会出现 bug，请重复整个过程，包括搜索 IP，并确保在登录显示为“NEW”的服务器时使用任何任务/SAI 访问按钮。

More servers can be unlocked on the side of RM7-S4L4 by hacking through them.
在 RM7-S4L4 一侧，通过黑入更多服务器可以解锁它们。

Connecting to D4RK RM7MI and other D4RK servers will unlock new servers in that direction.
连接到 D4RK RM7MI 和其他 D4RK 服务器将解锁该方向的新服务器。

More hidden connections can be revealed for redundant paths by searching the following IPs the same way as before. They will only be accessible if you have access to the servers they are connecting to, so unlock the map first.
通过像之前一样搜索以下 IP，可以为冗余路径揭示更多隐藏连接。只有当你能够访问它们所连接的服务器时，这些连接才会可用，所以请先解锁地图。

  • 855.529.2.1
  • 855.529.1.2
  • 855.529.1.13
  • 853.172.2.2
  • 854.266.7.1 (you must search this IP to unlock it, once you have the north server)
    854.266.7.1（你必须搜索这个 IP 才能解锁它，一旦你拥有北侧服务器）

Additional servers can now be unlocked
现在可以解锁更多服务器

RM7-W3NCP can be hacked to unlock RM7-W3L2 which when connected, unlocks RM7-W3L4 and RM7-W3L3.
RM7-W3NCP 可以被黑入以解锁 RM7-W3L2，连接后会解锁 RM7-W3L4 和 RM7-W3L3。

Connecting to RM7-W3L4 will give access to RM7-W3L1 which is also connectable via RM7-W3NCP
连接到 RM7-W3L4 将获得对 RM7-W3L1 的访问权限，该服务器也可通过 RM7-W3NCP 连接

There is a bugged server RM7-A2ES placed on the same server tile as RM7-W3NCP. It is possible to connect to either of the two servers using their IP addresses, 855.529.8.2 and 855.529.3.7 respectively.
有一个存在漏洞的服务器 RM7-A2ES 与 RM7-W3NCP 位于同一服务器区块。可以使用它们各自的 IP 地址 855.529.8.2 和 855.529.3.7 连接到这两台服务器中的任意一台。

End of Update – 15th June
更新结束 – 6 月 15 日

✅ 3.3 - Ghost Protocol
✅ 3.3 - 幽灵协议

Ghost Protocol
幽灵协议

June 26th ‘5cryp0l 0J’ software was added to the D4RK Market for purchase. However, we still receive an error when trying to decrypt the attack_logs.log file with the software equipped.
6 月 26 日，'5cryp0l 0J' 软件被添加到 D4RK 市场供购买。然而，当装备该软件尝试解密 attack_logs.log 文件时，我们仍然收到错误。


June 29th - Ghost Protocol was removed from the active quest list, but still shows an entry in the Codex. 

Update July 15th 

You are now able to open the attack_logs.txt file 

The mythical B43273N which contains chat_fragments.txt is also now available 

To connect / find B43273N, connect to the B43274N server and then search the IP “854.266.7.3” and it should appear. NOTE you will need ‘D-BADGER V2.2’ software installed in order to progress. This is found on the home server software section and costs 28.8k credits and requires 4.0 REP.  

(Thanks to costco_hotdog on discord helping with this info) 

Once you’ve hacked B43274N with D-BADGER V2.2 you can then proceed to B43273N to hack it.  

Opening the chat_fragments.txt file triggers the ability to message Unknown again 

Log back in to B43274N and download the blackbox.log file and decrypt it 

Then speak to Unknown again 

You will get a 4~ hour time gate 

Equip 5CRYPt0L 0J in your loadout then re-open the attack_logs.log file and hack it. Then chat with Chris in the CEDRT work chat and then update Aurana in the messenger as well.Then talk to Chris again directly and not in the CEDRT work chat. This leads you to 3.4 - Wings of Mars (the Drone) 

✅ 3.X - Black Ledger 

Black Ledger
黑色账本

Requirement: 5.0 reliability on the Home Server market.
需求：家用服务器市场 5.0 可靠性。

Connecting to the server RM7-S4L4 you can now download a new file:
连接到服务器 RM7-S4L4，你现在可以下载一个新文件：
cufgu ab ginhu Koute.png

Open the cufgu file, then open your Codex to the Black Ledger entry and open the ‘Personal Log - PALIMPSEST cipher’ entry. This will trigger the ability to message Unknown (The Palimpsest group)
打开 cufgu 文件，然后将你的 Codex 打开到黑色账本条目，并打开“个人日志 - PALIMPSEST 密码”条目。这将触发向 Unknown（The Palimpsest 组织）发送消息的能力。

You must now hire a mercenary from the USOL market at URM7-M to retrieve the container for Unknown. You have to purchase the first additional mercenary slot to be able to send a mercenary.
你现在必须在 URM7-M 的 USOL 市场雇佣一名雇佣兵，为 Unknown 取回集装箱。你必须购买第一个额外雇佣兵槽位才能派遣雇佣兵。

  • Note you require to have specialist unlocked from the home market, so you need 5.0 reliability on the home market first before you can hire.
    请注意，你需要先从本土市场解锁专家，因此你需要先在本土市场达到 5.0 可靠性才能雇佣。


It is guaranteed by design to FAIL this expedition. No interaction is required for its duration.
按设计，这次远征必定失败。在其持续期间无需任何操作。


After the expedition fails, re-examine the Codex entries for Black Ledger again. One will mention a failure and after reading the entry you should be able to contact Unknown again.
远征失败后，再次查看 Black Ledger 的 Codex 条目。其中一条会提到一次失败，阅读该条目后，你应该能够再次联系 Unknown。

Unknown will task you with downloading new files from URM7-S5L2, completion of this task will allow you to hire the USOL Elite Mercenary. The new files are ‘koute_message_fragment.txt’ and ‘MARKET_DIGITAL_SIGNATURES.dat
Unknown 会要求你从 URM7-S5L2 下载新文件，完成此任务后你将能够雇佣 USOL 精英佣兵。新文件是“koute_message_fragment.txt”和“MARKET_DIGITAL_SIGNATURES.dat”’

The mercenary should successfully complete the expedition this time (without any required interacting from you) and you can then turn in the KTE-4417 container to Unknown for a reward.
佣兵这次应该能成功完成远征（无需你进行任何必要交互），然后你可以将 KTE-4417 容器交给 Unknown 以获取奖励。

This interaction will complete the Black Ledger quest.
此交互将完成黑账本任务。

Logging into the server URM7-S5L2 even without having the Black Ledger quest started will allow you to download the file Hochmetall Security - Internal Inspection Order.png
即使没有开始黑账本任务，登录服务器 URM7-S5L2 也能让你下载文件 Hochmetall Security - Internal Inspection Order.png

Kouteoutpostadministration.corie

✅ 3.X - Expansion of the Stash
✅ 3.X - 藏匿处扩建

Expansion of the stash // Stolen Toolcase
藏匿处扩建 // 被盗工具箱

Requirement: 5.0 reliability on the Home Server market.
要求：家用服务器市场 5.0 可靠性。

Opening the Home Market allows you to select the Hire → Specialists Tab and contact the specialist. You will receive a messenger conversation with Veran.
打开国内市场后，你可以选择“雇佣”→“专家”选项卡并联系专家。你将收到与 Veran 的通讯对话。

Connecting to RM7-E1L3 you will see a set of new files ‘container_transfer.log’ and ‘incident_report_cargo_47.log
连接到 RM7-E1L3 后，你会看到一组新文件“container_transfer.log”和“incident_report_cargo_47.log”’

Open both files and their corresponding Codex Entries. Then connect to RM7-E1L5 and download and open ‘relay_trace_E1L5.log’ and open the corresponding Codex entry.
打开这两个文件及其对应的法典条目。然后连接到 RM7-E1L5，下载并打开“relay_trace_E1L5.log”，并打开对应的法典条目。

Next connect to RM7-N2L2 and download the ‘manifest_batch_MB-4071.png’ file. Open the file and its codex entry.
接下来连接到 RM7-N2L2，下载“manifest_batch_MB-4071.png”文件。打开该文件及其法典条目。

Then connect to SRM7-N4L2 and download the ‘transfer_order_TRF-19-RED.png’ file
然后连接到 SRM7-N4L2 并下载“transfer_order_TRF-19-RED.png”文件

Next you will need to dispatch any regular Merc from the home market to Old Depot 17 to retrieve the container.
接下来，你需要从本土市场派遣任意一名普通雇佣兵前往旧仓库 17 取回集装箱。



Once the case is returned, message Veran and turn in the case to complete the quest.
箱子送回后，给 Veran 发消息并上交箱子以完成任务。

This will now allow you to rent or permanently purchase Inventory Slots.
现在你将可以租用或永久购买库存槽位。

✅ 3.X - A deal with the unknown
✅ 3.X - 与未知者的交易

A deal with the unknown
与未知者的交易

The quest is completed by purchasing the Nutcracker firewall from the Home Market and giving it to the “Unknown User” via the messenger.
该任务通过从家庭市场购买胡桃夹子防火墙，并通过信使将其交给“未知用户”来完成。

✅ 3.X - Private Matters
✅ 3.X - 私事

Private Matters
私人事务

Go to RM7-N2ECP (located above the Home Server) and download the file “Valeriani_TM_Ozren_Navratil_request_3.odt” and open it
前往 RM7-N2ECP（位于家庭服务器上方），下载文件“Valeriani_TM_Ozren_Navratil_request_3.odt”并打开

At the bottom of the file, there will be a FREEL code, this code is unique to each player account. You can add the person using the messenger.
在文件底部，会有一个 FREEL 代码，此代码对每个玩家账户都是唯一的。你可以使用信使添加此人。



Talk to Ozren Navratil to progress the quest
与 Ozren Navratil 交谈以推进任务



Go to RM7-S4WCP (bottom left from the Home Server) and download the file “message_4237122_secured.eb54x”.
前往 RM7-S4WCP（从家庭服务器左下角进入）并下载文件“message_4237122_secured.eb54x”。

Editor’s Note: On second playthrough for this step I was able to obtain all 5 needed valuable files for the later step from this same server using the following HW combination with the Screener Pro R10 Software
编者注：在第二次游玩此步骤时，我能够从同一服务器上获取后续步骤所需的所有 5 个有价值文件，使用的是以下硬件组合与 Screener Pro R10 软件

And by making use of the ‘Search for valuable files’ option in the SAI Files interface.
并利用 SAI 文件界面中的“搜索有价值文件”选项。

Once downloaded, open and decrypt it.
下载完成后，打开并解密它。


Afterwards open the corresponding new Codex entry and continue talking to Ozren.
之后打开相应的新 Codex 条目，并继续与 Ozren 交谈。


Go to B43271N to collect the “d4_CTF_lott0792_p1.vrnm" file and then go to B43274N to collect the "d4_CTF_lott0792_p2.vrnm" file. Both files are needed as they need to be combined. To do so, just open one and press the “combine” button. Once combined, open the file.
前往 B43271N 收集“d4_CTF_lott0792_p1.vrnm”文件，然后前往 B43274N 收集“d4_CTF_lott0792_p2.vrnm”文件。两个文件都需要收集，因为它们需要合并。要合并，只需打开其中一个文件并按下“合并”按钮。合并完成后，打开该文件。

Next, you need to connect to D4RK RM7EG which will allow access to the website “4D4RKJUMP3RS.corie”. You need to create an account by entering a username and your FREEL ID. To get your FREEL ID, you can type “sysinfo” in the command terminal. You will be sent a verification code via Messenger.
接下来，你需要连接到 D4RK RM7EG，这将允许访问网站“4D4RKJUMP3RS.corie”。你需要通过输入用户名和你的 FREEL ID 来创建一个账户。要获取你的 FREEL ID，你可以在命令终端中输入“sysinfo”。你将通过 Messenger 收到一个验证码。

After, it will ask for a username that you want to connect to, input “ChuckTheFerry”.
之后，它会要求你输入想要连接的用户名，输入“ChuckTheFerry”。

Talk to Chuck and he will ask you to attach 5 valuable files from CEDRT servers, some will work, others wont. He will tell you which ones are good and bad when you hand them over.
和 Chuck 交谈，他会要求你从 CEDRT 服务器上附上 5 个有价值的文件，有些能用，有些不能用。当你把文件交给他时，他会告诉你哪些是好的，哪些是坏的。

Edit from GigaMonkeh: - When you find a file that works, you can actually keep going back to the same server and download it again after handing it in. He’ll accept the same 5 files, for me “temp_1086.tgz” I handed it in 3 times.
来自 GigaMonkeh 的编辑：——当你找到一个可用的文件时，你实际上可以在提交后再次回到同一台服务器并重新下载它。他会接受同样的 5 个文件，对我来说是“temp_1086.tgz”，我提交了 3 次。

Note: By using a File Search hacking module in your loadout you can successfully search servers for valuable files. Chuck will accept file types described as ‘illegal_activity’, ‘crime_evidence’, and ‘cor3_protocol_violation’.
注意：在你的装备中使用文件搜索黑客模块，你就可以成功地在服务器中搜索有价值的文件。Chuck 会接受被描述为“illegal_activity”、“crime_evidence”和“cor3_protocol_violation”的文件类型。



Once the files have been handed over, Chuck will provide a download for “Svyaz_PTLS2_LUCh.jpg”. Download and open it.
一旦文件被移交，Chuck 将提供一个“Svyaz_PTLS2_LUCh.jpg”的下载。下载并打开它。

Talk to Ozren again
再次与 Ozren 交谈

Talk to Chuck again (if you closed the browser and server, you will need to reconnect to the D4RK server and then the website)
再次与 Chuck 交谈（如果你关闭了浏览器和服务器，你需要重新连接到 D4RK 服务器，然后再连接到网站）

After achieving 93% completion within the quest, the quest will automatically complete after a roughly 12-hour timegate.
在任务中达到 93%的完成度后，任务将在大约 12 小时的等待时间后自动完成。

✅ 3.4 - Wings of Mars
✅ 3.4 - 火星之翼

Wings of Mars // The Drone
火星之翼 // 无人机

Drone Building
无人机制造

After you finish talking with Aurana connect to RM7-W3L4 and download Mantis_Blueprints.vbt
与 Aurana 交谈完毕后，连接至 RM7-W3L4 并下载 Mantis_Blueprints.vbt

This will unlock the drone building.
这将解锁无人机制造功能。

Talk to Chris directly (not in CEDRT work chat) he will task you with handling 3 initial tasks, these correspond to Stage 01 of the Drone which you will find in the Expeditions → Personal drone assembling tab. You’ll use this tab to turn in whatever is asked of you (credits, files, items, etc.) for each Stage.
直接与 Chris 联系（不要在 CEDRT 工作聊天中），他会给你分配 3 个初始任务，这些任务对应无人机的阶段 01，你可以在远征 → 个人无人机组装标签页中找到。你将使用此标签页来提交每个阶段所要求的内容（ credits、文件、物品等）。

The drone will need to do a test expedition after all building stages are completed. Once that is complete you will be free to send the drone out on expeditions. To date we know the drone cannot currently be perma-killed and requires at least 1 durability and 1 battery to go out on an expedition.
在所有建造阶段完成后，无人机需要进行一次测试探险。一旦完成，你就可以自由地派遣无人机进行探险了。迄今为止，我们知道无人机目前无法被永久杀死，并且至少需要 1 点耐久度和 1 块电池才能出发探险。

Original Investigatory Content
原始调查内容

There is currently a bugged/unknown trigger for a continued conversation with Aurana. This conversation leads to unlocking the Drone via a series of tasks with Chris Tong.
目前存在一个有 bug/未知的触发条件，可以与 Aurana 进行持续对话。这段对话会通过一系列与 Chris Tong 的任务解锁无人机。

Devs accidentally unlocked progression for the drone for 2 players and have since rescinded the progress, but the general steps will be documented below as well as what information we gathered from it.
开发者意外地为 2 名玩家解锁了无人机的进度，此后已撤销该进度，但大致步骤以及我们从中收集到的信息将记录在下方。

After you finish talking with Aurana connect to RM7-W3L4 and download Mantis_Blueprints.vbt
与 Aurana 谈完后，连接 RM7-W3L4 并下载 Mantis_Blueprints.vbt

This will unlock the drone building.
这将解锁无人机建造。

Talk to Chris directly (not in CEDRT work chat) he will task you with handling 3 initial tasks, these correspond to Stage 01 of the Drone which you will find in the Expeditions → Personal drone assembling tab. You’ll use this tab to turn in whatever is asked of you (credits, files, items, etc.) for each Stage.
直接与 Chris 对话（不是在 CEDRT 工作聊天中），他会给你 3 个初始任务，这些任务对应无人机的阶段 01，你可以在远征 → 个人无人机组装标签页中找到。你将使用此标签页来提交每个阶段所要求的内容（ credits、文件、物品等）。


(This is the Mantis_Blueprints.vbt file you can access it from both RM7-W3L4 and RM7-W3L3)
（这是 Mantis_Blueprints.vbt 文件，你可以从 RM7-W3L4 和 RM7-W3L3 访问它）

Once stage 1 is completed talk to Chris again
完成第 1 阶段后，再次与 Chris 交谈

Then choose which option you want in the Expeditions -> Drone Assembly window. It is currently unknown if the choice even matters, but we’re experimenting with both tracks to see if it is just a difference in money+time or makes an actual functional difference later on. For now the CUU is a 40k + 4 hour time gate while the Hangar is 15k and a 20 hour time gate.
然后在“远征 -> 无人机装配”窗口中选择你想要的选项。目前尚不清楚这个选择是否重要，但我们正在对两条路线进行实验，以确定它只是金钱和时间的差异，还是会在后续产生实际的功能性影响。目前，CUU 需要 4 万和 4 小时的时间门槛，而机库需要 1.5 万和 20 小时的时间门槛。

Daily News Quests
每日新闻任务

Beginning 19th August, 2026 with Update 3.85.0 we began receiving News Articles in the unified News App on our in-game taskbar. Each new day at 3:00 PM UTC a new article will be released. Each article brings with it 1, and in some cases 2, new fragment(s) to unlock on the USSDP-V1250_Rep.AD64 Virtual Disk we unlocked on the 19th August, 2026. Each fragment is tied to a character within the Codes section of the Virtual Disk.You must complete the other quests in Act 3 in order to reach the News Articles quests described below. Finishing the Drone build should not be required.
从 2026 年 8 月 19 日的 3.85.0 版本更新开始，我们开始在游戏内任务栏的统一新闻应用中收到新闻文章。每天 UTC 下午 3 点会发布一篇新文章。每篇文章都会带来 1 个，有时是 2 个新碎片，用于在我们于 2026 年 8 月 19 日解锁的 USSDP-V1250_Rep.AD64 虚拟磁盘上解锁。每个碎片都与虚拟磁盘代码区中的一个角色相关联。你必须完成第三幕中的其他任务，才能到达下面描述的新闻文章任务。完成无人机建造应该不是必需的。

It is VERY IMPORTANT that you keep your Codes private, they are unique to each player. The codes provide a discount to Fragmentary Order.
你的代码务必保密，这一点非常重要，它们对每位玩家都是唯一的。这些代码可为 Fragmentary Order 提供折扣。

Living Terraformer - 21st August
活体地球化改造者 - 8 月 21 日

Forum Text
论坛文本

In this article, I'm going to tell you the truth about Martian terraforming. Most people don't know this, but the real terraforming process on Mars uses blue mold. Not machines. Not towers. Not some shiny miracle engine from a corporate promo. Blue mold. A living culture grown in secret biolabs and then pushed into soil systems, filters, old terraforming units, water loops, oxygen lines, and everything else they don't show you in the brochures.
在这篇文章中，我要告诉你关于火星地球化改造的真相。大多数人不知道这件事，但火星上真正的地球化改造过程使用的是蓝色霉菌。不是机器。不是高塔。不是企业宣传片里那种闪闪发光的奇迹引擎。是蓝色霉菌。一种在秘密生物实验室中培育的活体菌群，然后被注入土壤系统、过滤器、旧的地球化改造装置、水循环系统、氧气管道，以及所有他们在宣传册里不会给你看的东西。

And before the smart people come in laughing, just use your head for five seconds. How do you change dead soil? How do you change air? How do you make a dead environment slowly turn into something that can hold life? You don't do that with metal boxes. Machines only pump, heat, mix, open valves, close valves. The real work is biological. Bacteria. Algae. Fungi. Mold. Small living things that eat, spread, adapt, and change the environment around them. Normal mold would die there, obviously. So they made another kind. A blue one. Something that can survive cold, radiation, acid, dry air, bad soil, and almost no water.
在聪明人进来嘲笑之前，先用你的脑子想五秒钟。你怎么改变死去的土壤？你怎么改变空气？你怎么让一个死寂的环境慢慢变成能承载生命的东西？你不可能用金属盒子做到这些。机器只会泵送、加热、混合、开阀门、关阀门。真正的工作是生物性的。细菌。藻类。真菌。霉菌。那些会进食、扩散、适应并改变周围环境的微小生命体。普通霉菌在那里当然会死。所以他们造了另一种。一种蓝色的。一种能在寒冷、辐射、酸性、干燥空气、恶劣土壤和几乎无水的情况下存活的东西。

At first it was just a tool. That is always how they sell it. Just a culture. Just a bio-layer. Just a stabilizing organism. Just a little helper for the terraforming systems. They put it into filters, pipes, vents, cleaning units, underground tanks, soil processors, all the places where nobody looks unless something starts leaking. And it worked. That is the funny part. It actually worked. The blue stuff started adapting. It started growing where it should not grow. It started feeding on things it should not be able to feed on. It started spreading through old systems like it knew where to go.
起初，它只是一个工具。他们向来都是这么推销的。只是一种培养物。只是一个生物层。只是一种稳定生物。只是地球化改造系统的一个小帮手。他们把它放进过滤器、管道、通风口、清洁装置、地下储罐、土壤处理器，所有那些除非开始泄漏否则没人会看一眼的地方。然后它奏效了。有趣的地方就在这里。它确实奏效了。那种蓝色的东西开始适应。它开始在不该生长的地方生长。它开始以它本不该能摄取的东西为食。它开始蔓延穿过旧系统，仿佛它知道该往哪里去。

So tell me why everyone is so sure it stayed stupid.
那告诉我，为什么所有人都这么确定它一直没开窍。

You leave a living thing inside old terraforming systems for years. Around heat, pressure, chemical waste, dead tissue, human waste, old control circuits, signal lines, sensor grids, and closed air loops. You let it sit there long enough to learn every little rhythm of the system. You think it stays "just mold" because some corporate scientist wrote that on a label? No. It becomes part of the system. Then it becomes the system.
你把一个活物留在老旧的地球化改造系统里好几年。周围是高温、高压、化学废料、死组织、人类排泄物、老旧控制电路、信号线、传感器网格，还有封闭空气循环。你让它在那里待得足够久，久到学会系统每一个细微的节律。你觉得它还是“只是霉菌”，就因为某个企业科学家在标签上这么写了？不。它会成为系统的一部分。然后它会成为系统本身。

Now look at RepEnt.
现在看看 RepEnt。

They tell you RepEnt bodies are clean grown shells. Empty bodies. Safe bodies. Remote-operated bodies. A miracle of modern labor. You buy a license, connect through the Dog Chip, control the body, do the job, disconnect, go home. Nice and simple. But that is not how bodies work. A body does not just accept another mind because you stuck a chip into it. A body fights. A body rejects. A body remembers. Unless you soften it first.
他们说 RepEnt 的身体是干净的培育壳。空的身体。安全的身体。远程操控的身体。现代劳动的奇迹。你买一个许可证，通过狗芯片连接，控制身体，完成工作，断开连接，回家。简单又美好。但身体不是这样运作的。身体不会因为你插了个芯片进去就接受另一个意识。身体会反抗。身体会排斥。身体会记住。除非你先把它软化。

That is where the blue mold comes in.
这就是蓝色霉菌的用处。

RepEnt bodies are not clean shells. They are people. Old people, broken people, erased people, reshaped people. They change the face, clean the memory, rebuild whatever they need to rebuild, and then they run the body through the blue culture until it becomes obedient enough to take an outside signal. The Dog Chip is not the real control system. The Dog Chip is just the leash. The mold is what makes the body stop resisting.
RepEnt 的身体不是干净的壳。它们是人。老人，破碎的人，被抹除的人，被重塑的人。他们改变面容，清除记忆，重建一切需要重建的东西，然后让身体经过蓝色培养液，直到它变得足够顺从，能够接受外部信号。狗芯片不是真正的控制系统。狗芯片只是缰绳。霉菌才是让身体停止抵抗的东西。

That is why operators come back weird after sessions. That is why they say their hands feel wrong. That is why they stop sleeping right. That is why some of them talk about the body still being there after they disconnect. They think it is stress. They think it is phantom feedback. They think it is "temporary dissociation." No. They touched the colony. For a few hours, they were plugged into something living that was also reading them back.
这就是为什么操作员在会话结束后回来时变得古怪。这就是为什么他们说自己的手感觉不对劲。这就是为什么他们开始睡不好觉。这就是为什么他们中有些人会说起断开连接后身体仍然在那里。他们以为那是压力。他们以为那是幻肢反馈。他们以为那是“暂时性解离”。不。他们触碰了菌落。有几个小时，他们接入了一个活着的、同时也在反向读取他们的东西。

And that is the part nobody wants to talk about.
而这就是没人愿意谈论的那部分。

Every operator teaches it. Every RepEnt session gives it more data. How people move. How people panic. How people follow orders. How people kill. How people obey. The blue mold was first used to terraform dead ground. Then it learned pipes. Then it learned bodies. Now it is learning minds.
每个操作员都在传授它。每次 RepEnt 会话都给它更多数据。人如何移动。人如何恐慌。人如何服从命令。人如何杀戮。人如何顺从。蓝色霉菌最初被用来改造死地。然后它学会了管道。然后它学会了身体。现在它正在学习心智。

So no, the living terraformer is not going to take over the Solar System by crawling across the floor like some monster from an old movie. It does not need to. People will carry it themselves. In RepEnt bodies. In filters. In medical cultures. In sealed containers. In "safe" lab samples. In Dog Chip programs. In every idiot who thinks he is just buying a job license and a future.
所以不，那个活体地形改造体不会像老电影里的某种怪物一样在地板上爬行来接管太阳系。它不需要。人们会自己携带它。在 RepEnt 身体里。在过滤器里。在医疗培养物里。在密封容器里。在“安全”的实验室样本里。在狗芯片计划里。在每个以为自己只是在购买一份工作许可和一个未来的白痴身上。

One day everyone will be connected to the same wet blue brain, and you will still call it progress.
终有一天，所有人都将连接到同一个湿漉漉的蓝色大脑，而你仍会称之为进步。

July
七月

You will have a new message “Hey Chris. Any news ?” available to send to Chris Tong in the messenger app. Complete the dialog and then message Aurana. Once finished talking to her, message Chris Tong again. After finishing that conversation, connect to RM7-N1L1 and download the file cedrt-ddab-bckp213451.cr3z. Unpacking it will give you a new folder, CEDRT Dossiers. There are 20~ files within the folder, most will be corrupted files you can skip over. Others will be .ab52 you can decrypt to either get another corrupted file or a dossier. Once you have decrypted all 5 files, check your codex entries and wait.
你将在信使应用中收到一条新消息“嘿，克里斯。有什么消息吗？”，可以发送给 Chris Tong。完成对话后，再给 Aurana 发消息。与她谈完后，再次给 Chris Tong 发消息。完成那段对话后，连接到 RM7-N1L1 并下载文件 cedrt-ddab-bckp213451.cr3z。解压后会得到一个名为 CEDRT Dossiers 的新文件夹。文件夹内约有 20 个文件，其中大部分是损坏文件，可以跳过。其余为 .ab52 文件，你可以解密它们，得到另一个损坏文件或一份档案。解密全部 5 个文件后，检查你的法典条目并等待。

This will leave you at 75% progressing through the quest and after a 5 hour timegate the quest will autocomplete providing you with the fragment.
这将使你在任务中的进度达到 75%，经过 5 小时的时间门槛后，任务将自动完成，并为你提供该碎片。

Illustrated steps:
图示步骤：

Need to find info on Miss Gromova
需要找到关于 Gromova 小姐的信息

Connect to RM7-N1L1 and download cedrt-ddab-bckp213451.cr3z from files tab
连接到 RM7-N1L1，并从文件选项卡下载 cedrt-ddab-bckp213451.cr3z

Double click on the cedrt-ddab-bckp213451.cr3z file and it’ll deploy the ‘CEDRT Dossiers’ folder onto your desktop.
双击 cedrt-ddab-bckp213451.cr3z 文件，它会在你的桌面上部署“CEDRT Dossiers”文件夹。

You need to decrypt all the dossier files one by one, either by having the correct decryption software equipped, or using ‘force hack’ with credits
你需要逐个解密所有档案文件，要么装备正确的解密软件，要么使用“强制破解”消耗信用点

Some files will be empty, some will be personnel files, you’ll need to decrypt all 20 to progress. In total you’ll get 5 dossier entries, and one of them will be Miss Natalia Gromova 
有些文件会是空的，有些会是人员档案，你需要解密全部 20 个文件才能推进进度。总共你会获得 5 条档案条目，其中一条会是 Natalia Gromova 小姐。

After 5 hour timegate
在 5 小时时间锁之后

August
八月

24-hour timegate after the July quest… just to get to the below steps
七月任务后的 24 小时时间门……仅仅是为了进入以下步骤

Talk to Chris Tong. You can either hack a server or hire a USOL Mercenary for this part. We would recommend hacking the server as there is currently a bug affecting the end state of the Mercenary option. Both options are listed has headings below, you need to hover next to the heading to expand them
与 Chris Tong 交谈。你可以选择入侵服务器或雇佣一名 USOL 雇佣兵来完成这部分。我们建议入侵服务器，因为目前存在一个影响雇佣兵选项最终状态的漏洞。两个选项都列在下方作为标题，你需要将鼠标悬停在标题旁边以展开它们

Server Hack Option
服务器入侵选项

He provides you an IP address 855.529.2.04, search for it in the Network map to discover the RM7-ST/A-S4 server. Connect to it, hack it, and download the e4-08-92251_auto_control_11-ST59.raw and e4-08-92251_auto_control_14-ST59.raw files, open both files in this particular order, then proceed to chat with Chris again.
他向你提供了一个 IP 地址 855.529.2.04，在网络地图中搜索它以发现 RM7-ST/A-S4 服务器。连接到它，入侵它，并下载 e4-08-92251_auto_control_11-ST59.raw 和 e4-08-92251_auto_control_14-ST59.raw 文件，按此特定顺序打开这两个文件，然后再次与克里斯交谈。

Mercenary - As of 9/6/2026 this WILL bug your Mercenary queue out DO NOT USE THIS OPTION
雇佣兵 - 截至 2026 年 9 月 6 日，此选项会导致你的雇佣兵队列出现故障，请勿使用此选项

For the Mercenary option, open the USOL Market and select any mercenary to send to Transmitter ST4-RM7 for the task of Data Extract.Upon completion of the raid the e4-08-92251_auto_control_11-ST59.raw and e4-08-92251_auto_control_14-ST59.raw files will be on your desktop. Open both files then proceed to chat with Chris again.
对于雇佣兵选项，打开 USOL 市场并选择任意一名雇佣兵，将其派往 Transmitter ST4-RM7 执行数据提取任务。突袭完成后，e4-08-92251_auto_control_11-ST59.raw 和 e4-08-92251_auto_control_14-ST59.raw 文件将出现在你的桌面上。打开这两个文件，然后再次与 Chris 聊天。

Next Step
下一步

We then have a 3 hour timegate before Chris will message us again. He will provide a file Staff_agent627_recommendation_letter.txt and instructions for connecting to 855.529.8.2 which is RM7-A2ES and the Freel ID for Natalia Gromova. The ID is unique to each player. You must be connected to the server in order to add the Freel ID via messenger to start the conversation with Natalia.
之后会有 3 小时的时间门槛，Chris 才会再次给我们发消息。他将提供一个文件 Staff_agent627_recommendation_letter.txt，以及连接到 855.529.8.2 的说明，该地址即 RM7-A2ES，还有 Natalia Gromova 的 Freel ID。该 ID 对每个玩家都是唯一的。你必须连接到服务器，才能通过信使添加 Freel ID，从而开始与 Natalia 的对话。

Connect to the RM7-W3NCP server and download the cedrt-ddab-bckp201751.cr3z file, decrypt it to gain the CEDRT Expedition Check folder. Make sure you are connected to the RM7-A2ES server or you will not receive the dialog option to send Natalia the files. This leaves us at 92% for the August quest and an unknown timegate for the next step.
连接到 RM7-W3NCP 服务器并下载 cedrt-ddab-bckp201751.cr3z 文件，解密后获得 CEDRT Expedition Check 文件夹。确保你已连接到 RM7-A2ES 服务器，否则你将不会收到向 Natalia 发送文件的对话选项。这样八月任务就达到了 92%，而下一步的时间门槛尚不明确。

5hr~ Timegate for autocomplete of the August quest.
5 小时~ 八月任务自动完成的时间门。



Strange Order - 6th September
奇异命令 - 9 月 6 日

Open the messenger and search PERSON Yael Dross. The result will have a User ID you can add via the messenger to contact Yael. This ID is unique per player. Once added Yael will send you an automated message containing a contact form. Once opened it will download to your desktop where you can examine the Info on the PDF and see an IP source for the document. This IP leads us to RM7-S4L4 – hack the server and download ‘client_list.txt’ and ‘ORDER_MANIFEST_ANO-2251-047.eb52x’ to decrypt it. Refresh your browser tab! Then reopen the original forum thread and the quest completes.
打开信使并搜索 PERSON Yael Dross。搜索结果中会有一个用户 ID，你可以通过信使添加该 ID 来联系 Yael。此 ID 对每位玩家都是唯一的。添加后，Yael 会向你发送一条包含联系表单的自动消息。打开后，它会下载到你的桌面，你可以在那里查看 PDF 上的信息，并看到该文档的 IP 来源。这个 IP 将我们引向 RM7-S4L4——入侵服务器并下载 'client_list.txt' 和 ORDER_MANIFEST_ANO-2251-047.eb52x' 来解密它。刷新你的浏览器标签页！然后重新打开原始论坛帖子，任务就完成了。

9 月 10 日更新：重新连接到 RM7-A2ES，继续与 Natalia 的对话，她最终会将一张照片下载到你的桌面，打开它继续聊天。聊天完成后，你可以再次给 Chris Tong 发消息。

Finish the conversation then either:

After finishing the chat with Natalia there is a 2 hour timegate. Should be at 50% for quest completion during the gate.
与 Natalia 完成对话后，会有 2 小时的时间锁。在时间锁期间，任务完成度应达到 50%。

Reconnect to RM7-A2ES and talk with Natalia again. She will provide you with a Sat Code [BXC9V0F], you’ll need it.
重新连接 RM7-A2ES 并再次与 Natalia 交谈。她会给你一个卫星代码[BXC9V0F]，你会需要它。

You will then need to connect to RM7-ST/A-S4 and download the LOOMING_Sat_control_v2_43_portable.exe file and, while still connected to RM7-ST/A-S4 open it. Enter the code BXC9V0F at the top and click access. Once it connects and loads the map you need to start marking humans and structures
然后你需要连接到 RM7-ST/A-S4 并下载 LOOMING_Sat_control_v2_43_portable.exe 文件，并在仍然连接到 RM7-ST/A-S4 的情况下打开它。在顶部输入代码 BXC9V0F 并点击访问。一旦它连接并加载地图，你需要开始标记人类和建筑

Download the resulting file and talk to Natalia after connecting to RM7-A2ES again. Finish the conversation and it appears we have another timegate as we are now at 78% on September.

There is a roughly 1-1.5 hour timegate after the above step. Natalia will reach out again to give you the results of the raid. Following the completion of the Chris Tong chat you will have a 5 hour timegate to autocompletion of the September quest. You should be at 94% when the timegate begins

Sept 12 0820 CST - Connect to RM7-A2ES again and chat with Natalia she sends you a new code BXV4Y3F - Make sure you reply back to her before continuing. Connect back to the RM7-ST/A-S4 server and run the LOOMING_Sat_control_v2_43_portable.exe file, enter the new code and wait for the satellite to load.
9 月 12 日 08:20 CST - 再次连接到 RM7-A2ES 并与 Natalia 聊天，她会给你一个新代码 BXV4Y3F - 确保在继续之前回复她。重新连接到 RM7-ST/A-S4 服务器并运行 LOOMING_Sat_control_v2_43_portable.exe 文件，输入新代码并等待卫星加载。
NOTE: Some weather conditions will block the satellite. Just wait a few mins and it will change. Dont forget the weather app on the toolbar.
注意：某些天气条件会阻挡卫星。只需等待几分钟，天气就会变化。别忘了工具栏上的天气应用。
Once loaded you should have 4 total areas of interest to click for the Satellite to lock in on before it will allow you to download BXV4Y3F_shot0.raw once you have that downloaded, open the file, then connect to RM7-A2ES again and chat with Natalia. She will provide you an audio file, open it to gain a codex entry, then continue the chat with Natalia. She will provide you with crates_markings.jpg, camp_exterior.jpg and cave_interiro.jpg, be sure to open all three files to trigger dialog with Aurana.
加载完成后，你应该有 4 个感兴趣区域需要点击，让卫星锁定，然后才能下载 BXV4Y3F_shot0.raw。下载完成后，打开该文件，然后再次连接到 RM7-A2ES 并与 Natalia 聊天。她会提供一个音频文件，打开它以获得一个法典条目，然后继续与 Natalia 聊天。她会为你提供 crates_markings.jpg、camp_exterior.jpg 和 cave_interiro.jpg，请务必打开所有三个文件以触发与 Aurana 的对话。

Finish the chat with Aurana then message Chris Tong and finish his conversation. You will be messaged by Cody Rennick who needs you to do 3 market jobs before you can message him. Do the jobs to have Cody unlocked. Then connect to RM7-E1SCP and download TRANSIT_BATCH_LOG_TRB-2231-0447 and open the file. While still connected to the RM7-E1SCP open your browser and go to the Trade & Shipment Database where you should now see the Table View tab where you enter a Transit Manifest ID from the file [TRB-2231-0447] and click Load. Once the table generates you need to checkbox only the [REDACTED] entries (make sure you get all of them, there should be 6 selected) and only then can you click Export and get a file output: ‘vessel_export.dat’. After opening the file you will be able to message James Curtis Fung with a request for help. From here we are at 93% on October and likely time-gated.
与 Aurana 结束聊天，然后给 Chris Tong 发消息并完成他的对话。Cody Rennick 会给你发消息，他需要你先完成 3 个市场任务才能给他发消息。完成这些任务即可解锁 Cody。然后连接到 RM7-E1SCP 并下载 TRANSIT_BATCH_LOG_TRB-2231-0447 并打开该文件。在仍然连接到 RM7-E1SCP 的情况下，打开浏览器并前往 Trade & Shipment Database，此时你应该能看到 Table View 标签页，在其中输入文件中的 Transit Manifest ID [TRB-2231-0447]并点击 Load。表格生成后，你只需勾选[REDACTED]条目（确保全部勾选，应该选中 6 个），然后才能点击 Export 并获得文件输出：'vessel_export.dat'。打开该文件后，你将能够给 James Curtis Fung 发消息请求帮助。至此，我们在 October 进度上达到 93%，且很可能存在时间限制。

ACT 3 - Expeditions
第三幕 - 远征


You may hire one merc at a time from the home market, on the hire tab. Their progress is visible on the expedition tab.
你可以在主市场的雇佣标签页一次雇佣一名佣兵。他们的进度可在远征标签页查看。
During the expedition, events can occur that modify the risk, and loot you receive. If you don't make a decision within the 5 min window, the default (usually safer, lower loot) option is taken.
探险期间可能发生事件，改变你面临的风险和获得的战利品。如果你未在 5 分钟窗口内做出决定，将采用默认选项（通常更安全，战利品更少）。

A List of all known items, and values of Expedition loot.
所有已知物品及探险战利品价值的列表。

It is not yet known what these are needed for although a (locked) craft and sell option exist. We will expand this page when the expedition goal is known.
目前尚不清楚这些物品的用途，尽管存在（锁定的）制作和出售选项。当探险目标明确后，我们将扩充此页面。

↘️ Jobs
↘️ 工作

ACT 3 - Jobs
第三幕 - 工作

Currently there are multiple known Markets available that can give Jobs for the player to complete, these are accessible on the Network Map.
目前有多个已知的市场可供玩家接取工作，这些市场可在网络地图上访问。
Home (Available from start)
家园（开局即可用）
D4RK RM7MI (Unlocked early in ACT 3)
D4RK RM7MI（在第三幕早期解锁）

Each server has a number of jobs available. All of them other than “File Decryption” involve a server on the Map.
每个服务器都有若干可用任务。除“文件解密”外，所有任务都涉及地图上的某个服务器。
Note: the Access Conditions -
注意：访问条件 -

If the Condition is "Acquisition", you will need to have hacked the server to login to it.
如果条件是“获取”，你需要已经黑入该服务器才能登录。
If the Condition is “Grant”, you are automatically given access while the Job is active.
如果条件是“授予”，则在任务激活期间你会自动获得访问权限。

If you remove a file / log or IP not requested via a job, the server will trip into maintenance, and cannot be accessed until the red timer on the map expires.
如果你删除了任务未要求的文件/日志或 IP，服务器将进入维护状态，在地图上的红色计时器到期之前无法访问。

You can refresh the job list (to scan if a job is complete) by clicking the Job button on the market, no need to navigate away and back.
你可以通过点击市场上的任务按钮来刷新任务列表（以扫描任务是否完成），无需离开页面再返回。

JOB TYPES:
任务类型：


File Decryption -
文件解密 -


Upon accepting the task, an encrypted file is added to your downloads folder. Simply double click it and complete the minigame, then back in the market, complete the job.
接受任务后，一个加密文件会被添加到你的下载文件夹中。只需双击它并完成小游戏，然后回到市场，完成任务。
The file will self delete from the folder.
该文件将自动从文件夹中删除。

IP Cleanup -

IP 清理 -

Connect to the server listed and on the Transit Access tab, click the delete button for the required IPs. Job Done.
连接到列出的服务器，并在“Transit Access”选项卡上，点击所需 IP 的删除按钮。任务完成。

IP (adding) -
IP（添加）-

Connect to the server listed and on the Transit Access tab, click the add button for the required IPs. Job Done.
连接到列出的服务器，并在“Transit Access”选项卡上，点击所需 IP 的添加按钮。任务完成。
NOTE: if you open the job info tab in the market, there is a copy button for each IP to save you manually typing each one.
注意：如果你在市场里打开任务信息标签页，每个 IP 都有一个复制按钮，省得你手动逐个输入。

Log Deletion -
日志删除 -


Connect to the listed server, and on the Log Tab, find the listed log, and click the delete button. Job done.
连接到列出的服务器，在日志选项卡上，找到列出的日志，然后点击删除按钮。任务完成。
NOTE: there can be more than one log with the same name, deleting the wrong file will put the server into maintenance after a short time, so be fast with multiple. It is possible to use F12 to find the actual file, but it is usually the one with the odd (smallest) size, the 3.86mb file in this case.
注意：可能存在多个同名日志，删除错误的文件会在短时间内使服务器进入维护状态，所以如果有多个要快速操作。可以用 F12 找到实际文件，但通常是那个大小异常（最小）的，本例中是 3.86mb 的文件。

Log Download -
日志下载 -

Connect to the listed server, and on the Log Tab, find the listed log, and click the download button. Job done.
连接到列出的服务器，在日志选项卡上找到列出的日志，然后点击下载按钮。任务完成。


File Elimination -
文件删除 -



Connect to the listed server, and on the Files Tab, find the listed file, and click the delete button. Job done.
连接到列出的服务器，在文件选项卡上找到列出的文件，然后点击删除按钮。任务完成。

File Download -
文件下载 -

Connect to the listed server, and on the Files Tab, find the listed file, and click the download button. Job done.
连接到列出的服务器，在文件选项卡中找到列出的文件，然后点击下载按钮。任务完成。

File Upload -
文件上传 -

Connect to the listed server, and on the Files Tab, click the upload button and navigate to the supplied file, it will be in your downloads folder. (Given when accepting the job.)

Component_board_tx-71review.txt

We receive a file called ‘Component_board_tx-71review.txt

If we remove all the gibberish (such as using the regex /[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/gm), we’re left with
如果我们去掉所有乱码（比如使用正则表达式 /[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/gm），剩下的就是

This component board is prixrqmqx
这个组件板是 prixrqmqx

This lines up with the first sentence, so if we take out what we know from that sentence, we’re left with xrqmqx 
这与第一句话相符，所以如果我们去掉从那句话中已知的内容，剩下的就是 xrqmqx

Not sure if it is a key for later on, or just some attempt at showing corruption/encryption being decoded in a file.
不确定它是后续会用到的密钥，还是只是为了展示文件中正在被解码的损坏/加密内容。

Install FFmpeg and the following CMD can be used to directly pull radio audio:
安装 FFmpeg 后，可使用以下 CMD 直接拉取广播音频：

@echo off

set "DURATION=00:01:00"

echo Starting 1-minute recording for all 8 channels...
echo 开始为全部 8 个频道录制 1 分钟……

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/wim1 -t %DURATION% -c copy wim1.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/5h3 -t %DURATION% -c copy 5h3.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/0a7e -t %DURATION% -c copy 0a7e.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/f1n0 -t %DURATION% -c copy f1n0.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/20gm -t %DURATION% -c copy 20gm.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/37.9M -t %DURATION% -c copy 37.9M.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/0.2ms -t %DURATION% -c copy 0.2ms.mp3

start /b ffmpeg -i https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/cp7n -t %DURATION% -c copy cp7n.mp3

echo All recordings are running in the background.
echo 所有录制都在后台运行。

echo This window will stay open until the 1 minutes are up.
echo 此窗口将保持打开，直到 1 分钟结束。

timeout /t 65 /nobreak

echo Done!
echo 完成！

pause
暂停

Change Duration to record longer, and filename at the end of the line. The timeout /t is in seconds and should be a little longer than the top set duration.
将录制时长改得更长，并将文件名放在行末。超时 /t 以秒为单位，应比顶部设置的时长稍长一些。


Alternate script from Dub on Discord
来自 Discord 上 Dub 的备用脚本

@echo off

setlocal enabledelayedexpansion

:loop

echo [%date% %time%] Starting ffmpeg...
echo [%date% %time%] 正在启动 ffmpeg...

ffmpeg ^

  -reconnect 1 ^

  -reconnect_streamed 1 ^

  -reconnect_delay_max 30 ^

  -reconnect_at_eof 1 ^

  -fflags +discardcorrupt ^

  -err_detect ignore_err ^

  -i "https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/rejvertkfytxkgbgk" ^

  -map a ^

  -vn -sn -dn ^

  -c copy ^

  -f segment ^

  -segment_time 300 ^

  -reset_timestamps 1 ^

  -strftime 1 ^

  -reset_timestamps 1 "71.5mhz_segments/stream_%%Y-%%m-%%d_%%H-%%M-%%S.mp3"
-reset_timestamps 1 "71.5mhz_segments/stream_Y-%%m-%%d_%%H-%%M-%%S.mp3"

echo [%date% %time%] ffmpeg exited with code %ERRORLEVEL%
echo [%date% %time%] ffmpeg 退出，代码为 %ERRORLEVEL%

echo Restarting in 2 seconds...
echo 2 秒后重启...

timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul

  • goto loop

All you have to do is update the output folder and the radio url (capture script).
你只需更新输出文件夹和广播 URL（捕获脚本）。

For the concat, just take the recordings into a new folder and run the following batch file too
对于合并，只需将录音放入一个新文件夹，然后也运行以下批处理文件

dir /b /on *.mp3 > list.tmp

(for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("list.tmp") do @echo file '%%i') > concat.txt
(for /f "usebackq delims=" i in ("list.tmp") do @echo file '%%i') > concat.txt

  • ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i concat.txt -c copy full_recording.mp3

ARCHIVE
档案

Loop 0 - Tutorial
循环 0 - 教程

00:00 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 00:00 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

Read Contract.pdf + Diary.pdf
阅读 Contract.pdf + Diary.pdf
Check the messenger with Aurana and reply to each message.
与奥拉娜一起查看信使，并回复每条消息。
To open Documents folder, the password is your FREEL_### from the top right without the @
要打开“文档”文件夹，密码是你右上角的 FREEL_###，不带 @

For example, mine would be FREEL_019BB847-FDC0
例如，我的密码是 FREEL_019BB847-FDC0

Open each document, there is a minigame for each document.
打开每个文档，每个文档都有一个小游戏。
You will also get a file on the desktop called “Fromafriend.png” to signify completion of this step. View it if you’d like.
你还会在桌面上得到一个名为“Fromafriend.png”的文件，表示这一步已完成。如果你想看的话可以查看它。
Return to messages with Aurana
返回与 Aurana 的消息
She will tell you to run the CLI Command “chmod 555 video”
她会让你运行 CLI 命令“chmod 555 video”
Reply to her and then click the terminal icon on the bottom of the screen ( >_ )
回复她，然后点击屏幕底部的终端图标（>_）
Type / paste in “chmod 555 video” and you can now access the video folder on your desktop
输入 / 粘贴“chmod 555 video”，现在你就可以访问桌面上的视频文件夹了
Open it and watch the video, this is the end of the tutorial loop.
打开它并观看视频，这就是教程循环的终点。

Following the video you will be placed on one of 4 loops below;
跟随视频，你将被置于以下 4 个循环之一；

You MUST follow the steps of the path you are on before progressing another.
你必须先完成你所在路径的步骤，才能继续下一个。

Loop 1 - Damaged Document
循环 1 - 损坏的文件

20:40 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频第 20 分 40 秒 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略
First Completion by JustJayz - Discord
JustJayz 首次通关 - Discord

You receive a message from Aurana, who says you’ve stumbled upon a file, which seems to be a report of sorts, but is very damaged. She thinks it's related to the experiments we’re investigating.
你收到来自 Aurana 的消息，她说你偶然发现了一个文件，看起来像是某种报告，但损坏严重。她认为这与我们正在调查的实验有关。

https://cdn.cor3.gg/corie/loops/1/damaged_document.jpg 

In the Document, you can find that the Investigation is carried out by Simon Webb.
在文档中，你可以发现调查是由西蒙·韦伯进行的。

Go to the messenger / CORIE Database and search PERSON Simon Webb
前往信使/CORIE 数据库并搜索人物西蒙·韦伯

This will provide his ID (which is unique per person), which you can use to add him as a contact in the messenger.
这将提供他的 ID（每个人都是唯一的），你可以用它来在信使中将他添加为联系人。

Once added, he will reach out asking what you want, and will eventually provide you with a website link to an old archive:
添加后，他会主动联系你询问你想要什么，并最终会向你提供一个旧档案的网站链接：
https://viibot.corie/archives
A file will be added to your desktop, its name is a hint to the file you need on the archive. Note its starting letter to narrow down the correct result.
桌面上会添加一个文件，其名称是对你在档案中所需文件的提示。记下它的首字母，以缩小正确结果的范围。
It will be named a letter and then symbols. Either A or B.
它的命名方式是一个字母后跟符号。要么是 A，要么是 B。
E.G. - A%-!%^@!@
例如 - A%-!%^@!@
You need to find the classified document, the rating is in the top right. There are also three restricted docs.
你需要找到机密文件，评级在右上角。还有三份受限文件。


You only need the classified document, in it, view the image of the case, it has 104MHz hidden in it, and then tune the radio to the range 102-104MHz (this is hidden at the top of the case image) it will play morse code eventually on one of the freqs. Cycle through them. Morse will begin when the wind in the weather app is facing East.
你只需要那份机密文件，在里面查看案件图片，其中隐藏着 104MHz，然后把收音机调到 102-104MHz 范围（这隐藏在案件图片的顶部），最终它会在其中一个频率上播放摩尔斯电码。循环切换这些频率。当天气应用中的风向朝东时，摩尔斯电码就会开始。
The “Channel” will read d55pe18 on all correct freqs.
在所有正确的频率上，“频道”都会显示 d55pe18。
https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/d55pe18
The Morse translates to "LOOK DEEPER INTO THE WEB CODE"
摩尔斯电码翻译为“深入查看网页代码”

If you close and reopen the classified report and look at the code in the browser, you will find a highlighted word hidden there “deeper”, click the word deeper to progress the discussion with Simon. Aurana will message you and thus completes this Loop. This only shows AFTER hearing the morse, and refreshing the browser (navigating away or close/reopen)
如果你关闭并重新打开机密报告，然后在浏览器中查看代码，你会发现那里隐藏着一个高亮词“deeper”，点击“deeper”这个词来推进与 Simon 的讨论。Aurana 会给你发消息，从而完成这个循环。这只会出现在听完摩尔斯电码并刷新浏览器之后（离开页面或关闭/重新打开）

Loop 2 - Nutcracker Site
循环 2 - 胡桃夹子网站

First Completion by Paralizard - Discord
首次完成者：Paralizard - Discord

05:28 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 05:28 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

You will receive a message from “The Algorithm” which grants you access to the site
你将收到来自“算法”的消息，它会授予你访问该网站的权限

The NutCracker: https://forum.corie/main 
The NutCracker：https://forum.corie/main

  1. Go to the nutcracker forum, The top 3 posts are useful, but only the first and third need viewing. The first has a link in the first comment to archive.corie/main. Click that to unlock that page on the left of your browser
    前往 nutcracker 论坛，前 3 篇帖子很有用，但只需查看第一和第三篇。第一篇的第一条评论中有一个指向 archive.corie/main 的链接。点击该链接即可在浏览器左侧解锁该页面
  2. Go to the 3rd post, scroll down until you find the quote block that has a token at the bottom. copy that token
    前往第 3 篇帖子，向下滚动，直到找到底部带有 token 的引用块。复制该 token
  3. connect_site --token=tokenfromnutcracker in terminal. This information is given on the 2nd post, but not needed to be viewed. this enables the Astrocrop site for 15 minutes
    在终端中运行 connect_site --token=tokenfromnutcracker。此信息在第 2 篇帖子中给出，但无需查看。这会使 Astrocrop 网站启用 15 分钟
    for example:    connect_site --token=qStpdTou6FxxuSbDgQ9Q
    例如：connect_site --token=qStpdTou6FxxuSbDgQ9Q



Be careful not to mix up 0 and O, and 1 and l.
注意不要混淆 0 和 O，以及 1 和 l。
There is an example of a 1 in the first image, second to last character
第一张图片中有一个 1 的示例，位于倒数第二个字符

Be careful with the font if you are manually typing it out rather than copying it via F12/Inspector
如果你是通过手动输入而不是通过 F12/检查器复制，请注意字体。

  1. Go to the Astrocrop site, open files from the top right of the browser, by clicking the <> button, then the Files tab and download logs.txt
    前往 Astrocrop 网站，从浏览器右上角打开文件，点击 <> 按钮，然后进入“文件”选项卡并下载 logs.txt
  2. Sift through logs.txt to find the main offender ID. copy it, The line is WAF Block applied Id #####
    在 logs.txt 中筛选，找到主要违规者 ID。将其复制，该行内容为 WAF Block applied Id #####
  3. Before the site shuts down, run block_id IDFROMLOGS In terminal e.g. block_id 123456
    在网站关闭之前，在终端中运行 block_id IDFROMLOGS，例如 block_id 123456
  4. You should get a message from "Unknown User"
    你应该会收到一条来自“Unknown User”的消息
  5. Go through the conversation, afterwards, he will “hack” you. Prepare to press your number keys when the rows light up red to reset them. If 1 goes red, hit 1 on your keyboard before the timer runs out.
    浏览对话后，他会“黑入”你。当行亮起红灯时，准备按下对应的数字键来重置它们。如果 1 变红，在计时结束前按下键盘上的 1。
  6. This will then be followed by the standard Firewall Breach minigame.
    随后会进入标准的防火墙突破小游戏。
  7. You will get a new file on the desktop and more messages from Aurana and move to another loop.
    你会在桌面上获得一个新文件，收到更多来自 Aurana 的消息，并进入下一个循环。

Loop 3 - Blueprints
循环 3 - 蓝图

First Completion by xHughx/Mr.Souer - Discord
首次通关由 xHughx/Mr.Souer - Discord

14:10 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 14:10 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略



Decode the Blueprints with a minigame each then in the messenger to corie advisor:
通过每个小游戏解码蓝图，然后在信使中发送给科里顾问：
These Filenames are discovered with a mix of the file’s information and what can be seen in the corrupt file.
这些文件名是通过文件信息与损坏文件中可见内容的结合而发现的。

FILE Blueprint M-VI571
文件蓝图 M-VI571
FILE Blueprint M-1509i  文件蓝图 M-1509i
FILE Blueprint 771-A  文件蓝图 771-A
FILE Blueprint S-1745  文件蓝图 S-1745

You are then sent a Password.txt
随后你会收到一个 Password.txt 文件
The password you require is one off the list at random to open the last blueprint.
你需要的密码是列表中随机抽取的一个，用于打开最后一份蓝图。
Each failed attempt locks the file for 30 seconds incrementally (30, 60, 90s etc)
每次尝试失败都会锁定文件 30 秒，并逐次递增（30、60、90 秒等）

The last file to pull is FILE Blueprint 771-B
最后要提取的文件是 FILE Blueprint 771-B

Message with Aurana then run in terminal
与 Aurana 互发消息，然后在终端中运行

scan artemis
scp artemis

You will now have a folder on your desktop, Artemis
现在你的桌面上会有一个名为 Artemis 的文件夹
Open the puzzle locked files and find the circled date 01.12.2177
打开谜题锁定的文件，找到圈出的日期 01.12.2177
This is the password for the locked file.
这是锁定文件的密码。

Open it and talk to aurana to progress to the next loop.
打开它并与 aurana 交谈，以推进到下一个循环。

Loop 4 - USOL CDC / SkyARC.txt
循环 4 - USOL CDC / SkyARC.txt

First Completion by ImGoingSpace - Discord
ImGoingSpace 的首次通关 - Discord

09:25 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 09:25 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

You will receive a message from Aurana after watching the video telling you to look at the sky lift incident and connect to an old usol cdc archive.
观看视频后，你会收到来自 Aurana 的消息，让你查看空中缆车事故，并连接到一个旧的 usol cdc 档案。
Open the browser.  打开浏览器。
Go to the Infinite Memory site and in the top left, click the <> icon, then you should see three files, SKY_ARC.txt and two images, view the images and open skyarc. It will add to the desktop.
前往 Infinite Memory 网站，在左上角点击 <> 图标，然后你应该会看到三个文件，SKY_ARC.txt 和两张图片，查看这些图片并打开 skyarc。它会添加到桌面。

From skyarc, there is a token in the file, copy this, it is unique per user.
在 skyarc 中，文件中有一个令牌，复制它，每个用户的令牌都是唯一的。
In the terminal, enter connect usol cdc --password=YOURTOKEN
在终端中，输入 connect usol cdc --password=YOURTOKEN

4 of these files are valid, you need to guess which are correct.
这些文件中有 4 个是有效的，你需要猜出哪些是正确的。
Example commands -   示例命令 -
scp A9_17B

scp SKL_O41

scp REC_A3

scp NT_FG22

scp OPS221X

scp R12_E

scp FRG_R1

scp AU_9D

scp S17K

scp BLK03

scp XM5_A

scp L041

scp RCP78

scp U_A1

scp BRK2

The list of files is different for each user. Keep trying until you get all 4.
每个用户的文件列表都不同。不断尝试，直到你集齐全部 4 个。
You will be given a new folder on the desktop called Reports
你的桌面上会出现一个名为 Reports 的新文件夹
Look through the 5 files you can open, one is 5.0 Reputation locked.
查看你能打开的 5 个文件，其中一个是 5.0 声望锁定的。
The other 4 files are the same but have different names for each user.
另外 4 个文件内容相同，但每个用户的文件名不同。
Take any full names you can find and in the corie advisor do a PERSON search for those names
找到你能找到的任何全名，然后在 corie 顾问中进行 PERSON 搜索这些名字
e.g.  例如


PERSON martin skypovski

You will find one profile that is complete with a 6 digit ID
你会找到一个完整的个人资料，带有一个 6 位数的 ID


Take that 6 digit ID and add them via the messenger “Add Contact”
将那个 6 位 ID 通过通讯软件“添加联系人”添加

Talk through their dialogues and review the two files they send, then report back to Aurana to complete the loop.
与他们对话并查看他们发送的两个文件，然后向 Aurana 汇报以完成循环。

Post Loop Investigation:
循环后调查：

First Completion by TheColonel - Discord
TheColonel 的首次完成 - Discord

24:50 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 24:50 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

After completing all 4 loops, revisit the astrocrop archive and download all available files. One is rep locked to 4.0, which you now have, Sandman and sons.
完成所有 4 个循环后，重新访问 astrocrop 档案并下载所有可用文件。其中一个文件需要 4.0 声望解锁，你现在已经拥有了，桑德曼和他的儿子们。

We also have, in the reports folder, a file OPS_Archive which is 5.0 Rep locked.
在 reports 文件夹中，我们还有一个文件 OPS_Archive，需要 5.0 声望解锁。
You can run PERSON commands on the names in this file, of the Col and Majors
你可以对此文件中的 Col 和 Majors 名字运行 PERSON 命令

PERSON Augustus Nordman
PERSON Frank Kirch

You do not need to do these at this time, but one name will be used later.
你目前不需要做这些，但稍后会用到其中一个名字。

Rep 5 - Trade & Shipment Database:
Rep 5 - 贸易与货运数据库：

First Completion by TheColonel/ImGoingSpace
首次通关由 TheColonel/ImGoingSpace 完成

Upon completing all 4 loops and talking with Aurana, Your diary on the desktop will update, open it, then you will receive a manifest file and folder, open this file and continue the discussion. Aurana will give you a link to a site telling you to run some CLI commands.
完成全部 4 次循环并与 Aurana 交谈后，你桌面上的日记将会更新，打开它，然后你会收到一个清单文件和文件夹，打开这个文件并继续讨论。Aurana 会给你一个网站链接，告诉你在其中运行一些 CLI 命令。

Run auth_probe trade_shipment in the terminal and you will see a list of codes.
在终端中运行 auth_probe trade_shipment，你会看到一列代码。
For each of these you need to run “auth_check” ID, this list is the same for everyone but in a different order. 3 of them will be valid, so once you have 3/3 you dont need to auth check the rest:
对于每一个代码，你需要运行“auth_check” ID，这个列表对每个人都是一样的，但顺序不同。其中有 3 个是有效的，所以一旦你达到 3/3，就不需要再对其余的进行 auth check 了：

Auth_check BxfBj
Auth_check sxMyG
Auth_check UGrwI
Auth_check WHpQB
Auth_check p6ny2

Auth_check FZlms
Auth_check 3G1y5
Auth_check 6A9Hb

Take your 3 segments and Auth_check 1-2-3, e.g. (it can be in any order, so there are six permutations)
将你的 3 个片段和 Auth_check 1-2-3 组合起来，例如（顺序可以任意，因此共有六种排列）
auth_check WHpQB-6A9Hb-sxMyG

A hint for this is in the “code” for the shipment site, hidden in a ROT13 cypher.
关于这一点的提示隐藏在货运网站的“代码”中，以 ROT13 密码加密。


We then need some ID’s. luckily the manifests document we just got is full of them!
然后我们需要一些 ID。幸运的是，我们刚拿到的舱单文件里到处都是！

We are interested in the Solaris ship’s IDs, listed here for convenience
我们关注的是 Solaris 飞船的 ID，为方便起见，现列于此处
| #  | Ship Name (leetspeak variant) | Registry ID     |
| # | 飞船名称（leet 变体） | 注册 ID |

| 14 | S0|@ri5 | QRS-5817-WX |

One of these IDs will give a different result, some may 404, if they do 404, use the back button in the virtual browser (NOT YOURS!) to save bandwidth
其中一个 ID 会给出不同的结果，有些可能会返回 404，如果返回 404，请使用虚拟浏览器中的后退按钮（不是你的！）以节省带宽
The One we want will say REPNODE-M7 followed by a unique, per user ID
我们想要的那个会显示 REPNODE-M7，后面跟着一个每个用户唯一的 ID

Search this ID and you'll see an image of a Silo lid. Your Diary will now update.
搜索这个 ID，你会看到一张筒仓盖的图片。你的日记现在会更新。
Read it and note the name to search up PERSON Seamus Malkob
阅读并记下要搜索的名字：PERSON Seamus Malkob

He will have a user ID to add. Converse with him. Once complete in the browser, go back to Astrocrop Archive and on the files tab, download SBS4 and Demeter.
他会有一个可添加的用户 ID。与他交谈。在浏览器中完成后，返回 Astrocrop Archive，在文件选项卡中下载 SBS4 和 Demeter。

A folder is added to the desktop that is PW Protected, the password is in the manifests file. It is on the line:
桌面上会添加一个受密码保护的文件夹，密码在清单文件中。它在以下这一行：
“Sealed fluid modules (BIOHAZARD WARNING), SBS4-######”
“密封流体模块（生物危害警告），SBS4-######”
The password is the SBS4-##### At the end of this line. the whole thing, including SBS4.
密码是本行末尾的 SBS4-#####，包括 SBS4 在内的全部内容。
Open both files and the diary updates again. Read it once more. Aurana will message you and send over 5 IDs to add as a contact. The third ID will add a contact “V3 News”.
打开两个文件，日记会再次更新。再读一遍。Aurana 会给你发消息，并发送 5 个 ID 让你添加为联系人。第三个 ID 会添加一个联系人“V3 News”。
The Diary updates once more, read it. It states to look back through files for names relating to Mars, there are two -
日记再次更新，读一下。上面写着要翻阅文件，寻找与火星相关的名字，有两个——
PERSON Thomas Albertson
人物 Thomas Albertson
His Profile has an ID on the top right now, Add him. And talk through his dialogue to be told about a prototype called “Gobbler”
他的个人资料右上角现在有一个 ID，添加他。然后通过他的对话了解一个名为“Gobbler”的原型
Then search for FILE Gobbler to see a new image to gain +0.1 rep.
然后搜索 FILE Gobbler 以查看新图像，获得+0.1 声望。

From the OPS txt file, - PERSON Augustus Nordman
从 OPS txt 文件中，- 人员 Augustus Nordman

Talk through his dialog and you will be messaged by Aurana again.
通过他的对话，Aurana 会再次给你发消息。
She will give you a password to use the updater at the bottom toolbar.
她将给你一个密码，用于底部工具栏的更新程序。

Rep 6 - Updated Corie:
Rep 6 - 更新后的 Corie：

Once updated you will see new items on the taskbar you cannot use yet.
更新后，你会在任务栏上看到一些尚无法使用的新物品。
You’ll need to save up 4,500CR to “move” to REPNODE-M7.
你需要积攒 4500CR 才能“迁移”到 REPNODE-M7。

You will need to have completed 7 daily tasks to save this many CR.
你需要完成 7 个每日任务才能保存这么多 CR。

Buying the ticket leads to a timer ending Feb 1, 2026 at 1500GMT
购买门票后，计时器将于 2026 年 2 月 1 日 15:00 GMT 结束
https://m7.repnodemassive.tech/ 

Stage 1: 0 to 4 Fragments
阶段 1：0 到 4 个碎片

First Completion by Para & GigaMonkeh - Discord
首次完成者：Para & GigaMonkeh - Discord

After clicking “Depart” on the M7 ship, you will get a message from Aurana telling you to collect your things and you’ll go back outside the terminal. Click the Armor on the left table, the bag on the floor and on the shelf above the bag, the small white device.
在 M7 飞船上点击“出发”后，你会收到来自 Aurana 的消息，让你收拾东西，然后你会回到航站楼外面。点击左边桌子上的护甲、地板上的包以及包上方架子上的那个白色小设备。
You will be taken to the M7 site and trailer, click Cor3.gg at the bottom, then “Wake Up”
你将被带到 M7 站点和拖车处，点击底部的 Cor3.gg，然后点击“唤醒”

Back in the terminal this device is a new option on the bottom menu and needs decoding.
回到终端后，这个设备会成为底部菜单中的一个新选项，需要进行解码。

Review the device, rotate the model for info, then insert the disk. look at all its details to find a mention of the corietech.corie website. You need to manually type this URL in.
查看该设备，旋转模型以获取信息，然后插入磁盘。查看其所有细节，找到对 corietech.corie 网站的提及。你需要手动输入这个网址。

Manually browse in CORIE browser to: https://coretech.corie/model-MR-7-Media-Reader-78x/SN-A2089-99D-3K201
在 CORIE 浏览器中手动浏览至：https://coretech.corie/model-MR-7-Media-Reader-78x/SN-A2089-99D-3K201

Download manual_324.txt and download the CORE-CADL-BASIC link. This will add files to your desktop
下载 manual_324.txt 并下载 CORE-CADL-BASIC 链接。这会将文件添加到你的桌面


Then browse to: https://coretech.corie/products/consumer/other-components 
然后浏览至：https://coretech.corie/products/consumer/other-components

At the top, product solutions > Computing & System components > Other PC
在顶部，产品解决方案 > 计算与系统组件 > 其他 PC
And download the v.1.16.05 firmware update for CST-HR23 Rev.B
并下载适用于 CST-HR23 Rev.B 的 v.1.16.05 固件更新

You will now have various files downloaded and applications ready to start decoding the harddrive which is our next step
现在你将下载好各种文件并准备好应用程序，可以开始解码硬盘了，这是我们下一步要做的事


Decoding the drive
解码硬盘
Open the MR-7 Media Reader 78X application in your task part, and click on the hard drive to load it. This will then open a new mini-game. The manual for the mini-game is on your desktop in the file “manual.txt”, it’s an extensive document, but the steps do not appear to be unique for everyone can just be followed as per below.
在你的任务栏中打开 MR-7 Media Reader 78X 应用程序，然后点击硬盘将其加载。随后会打开一个新的小游戏。小游戏的说明书在你的桌面上，文件名为“manual.txt”，这是一份内容详尽的文档，但其中的步骤似乎并非因人而异，只需按照以下步骤操作即可。

Select FIX and it’ll pop up the mini-game. In this mini-game you have 3 attempts through a 10-timer, however if you fail it’ll just take you back to the beginning, there is no cooldown or timegames fortunately.
选择 FIX，它会弹出小游戏。在这个小游戏中，你有 3 次尝试机会，限时 10 秒，不过如果失败，只会把你送回起点，幸运的是没有冷却时间或时间限制。

There are multiple steps to the mini-game, and each requires you change various settings to go to the next.
这个小游戏有多个步骤，每一步都需要你更改各种设置才能进入下一步。

E-27 Steps:
E-27 步骤：

FREQ B
频率 B

Press SERVICE button
按下 SERVICE 按钮

FREQ A
频率 A

FILTER ON
滤波器开启

Enter DIGITS: 555
输入数字：555

E-41 Steps:
E-41 步骤：

FILTER OFF
关闭过滤器

POWER OFF
关闭电源

Enter DIGITS: 99235
输入数字：99235

POWER ON
开机

Enter CALIBRATION mode,
进入校准模式，

Set all three:
将以下三项全部设置：

FILTER: ON
滤波器：开启

SHIELD: ON
防护开启

FREQ: A
频率：A

POWER OFF
电源关闭

Hold SERVICE button (for around 5 seconds, use the time left timer to help)
按住维修按钮（约 5 秒，可利用剩余时间计时器辅助）

POWER ON
开机

If done successfully device state will now be in CALIBRATION mode
如果操作成功，设备状态现在将处于校准模式

The status code will now cycle through the below 4 key words in a random order, enter the corresponding codes below;
状态代码现在将按随机顺序循环显示以下 4 个关键词，请在下方输入对应的代码；

END - enter 7
结束 - 输入 7

ERROR - enter 21
错误 - 输入 21

LEAD- enter 44
线索 - 输入 44

FALSE - 14
错误 - 14

E-52 Resolution (60% SYNC)
E-52 决议（60% 同步）

Set configuration
设置配置

FILTER: OFF
滤波器：关闭

SHIELD: OFF
屏蔽：关闭

FREQ: C
频率：C

In this next part for E-52, the Power and Lock status icons will flash in various sequences, such as power flashes once, none or twice, and you need to enter corresponding code from the manual.txt on desktop, however they appear to be the same for all players.
在 E-52 的下一部分中，电源和锁定状态图标将以各种序列闪烁，例如电源闪烁一次、不闪烁或闪烁两次，你需要从桌面上的 manual.txt 中输入相应的代码，然而这些代码对所有玩家来说似乎都是相同的。

Enter code in this order:
按此顺序输入代码：

2, 1, 6, 5

SYNC should now be at 80% with status “Service Required”
SYNC 现在应达到 80%，状态为“需要维修”

Re-Enter CALIBRATION mode,
重新进入 CALIBRATION 模式，

Set all three:
将三项全部设置：

FILTER: ON
过滤器：开启

SHIELD: ON
屏蔽：开启

FREQ: A
频率：A

POWER OFF
关机

Hold SERVICE button (for around 5 seconds, use the time left timer to help)
按住 SERVICE 按钮（约 5 秒，可使用剩余时间计时器辅助）

POWER ON
开机

Device state should be now CALIBRATION with current SYNC at 80%
设备状态现在应为 CALIBRATION，当前 SYNC 为 80%

The status code will now cycle through the below 2 key words in a random order, enter the corresponding codes below;
状态码现在将按随机顺序循环显示以下 2 个关键词，请在下方输入对应的代码；

TOOL = 27

LOOP = 6

SYNC should now be at 100%, click READ to finish the mini-game
SYNC 现在应该达到 100%，点击 READ 完成这个小游戏

This is currently a bugged minigame and requires the COR3 Dev team to fix it!
这目前是一个有漏洞的小游戏，需要 COR3 开发团队来修复它！

It appears to work in the current build of firefox, alternately you can temporarily work around this by using this Firefox extension https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/cors-everywhere/
它在当前版本的 Firefox 中似乎可以正常运行，或者你可以暂时通过使用这个 Firefox 扩展来绕过此问题 https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/cors-everywhere/
